report.summary: Five reviewed findings: high-severity missing None check in codex_cli.py and unvalidated digest in subject_for; medium-severity ambiguous untracked sentinel and baseline recall assumption; high-severity missing _verify_reachable in worktree.py. All need inspection before delivery.
risks: If shutil.which returns None, codex_cli.py may raise TypeError, blocking all codex tasks.
If subject_for accepts both sha256 and payload without validation, inconsistent ledger entries may go undetected.
Ambiguous -1 untracked could cause silent logic errors in docref_gate or harness.
eval_baseline_candidates skipping tasks with baseline recall 1.0 may miss regressions.
If _verify_reachable is missing or a no-op, worktree containment is ineffective, risking host compromise.
todos: Inspect daedalus/providers/codex_cli.py for shutil.which usage and add None guard.
Test subject_for with mismatched sha256 and payload; add validation if needed.
Check consumers of untracked in docref_gate.py and harness.py for disambiguation.
Inspect eval_baseline_candidates in picker.py for current recall check.
Search for def _verify_reachable in daedalus/kairos/worktree.py and verify implementation.
